title: Sindh Irrigation and Drainage Authority Amendment Ordinance 2002

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Irrigation and Drainage Authority Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

SINDH IRRIGATION AND DRAINAGE AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
SINDH IRRIGATION
AND DRAINAGE AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE VI OF 2002
An Ordinance to
amend the Sindh Irrigation and Drainage Authority Act, 1997
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 13th February, 2002]
NO. S.LEGIS: 1(6)/2002 dated
13‑2‑2002.‑‑‑The following Ordinance made by
the Governor of Sindh is hereby published for general information:‑‑
1. Short title and
commencement.‑‑‑(1) This Ordinance may be called the
Sindh Irrigation and Drainage Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Irrigation and Drainage Authority Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Amendment of Section 4 of Sindh Act No. IV of 1997

SINDH IRRIGATION AND DRAINAGE AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
SINDH IRRIGATION
AND DRAINAGE AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE VI OF 2002
An Ordinance to
amend the Sindh Irrigation and Drainage Authority Act, 1997
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 13th February, 2002]
NO. S.LEGIS: 1(6)/2002 dated
13‑2‑2002.‑‑‑The following Ordinance made by
the Governor of Sindh is hereby published for general information:‑‑
2. Amendment of Section 4 of
Sindh Act No. IV of 1997.‑‑In the Sindh Irrigation and Drainage
Authority Act, 1997, hereinafter referred to as the said Act, in section 4, in
subsection (1), for clause (h), the following shall be substituted:
"(h) Five representatives
of Farmers Orgnizations three from Sukkur Barrage Command and one each from
Gudu Barrage Command and Kotri Barrage Command; provided that where Farmers
Organizations are not formed such members may be selected by the Authority.
"
Members
